oral_examination.oral_examination: The gums in the whole mouth are red and swollen, and they bleed easily when probed, and the periodontal pockets are not reached. Tartar ( ), tooth surface pigment.

treatment_plan.notes: 1. Maintain oral hygiene and develop good habits of brushing and flossing correctly and conscientiously. Conduct regular oral examinations every 3-6 months. If you feel any discomfort, contact your attending doctor promptly. 2. If pulp symptoms occur, perform root canal treatment instead. 3. Always ask for follow-up consultation if you feel unwell.
